summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for BIKTARVY (NDA210251). The FDA multidiscipline review states in Section 10 that an AC meeting was not held because there were previously approved drugs in the ARV class, the safety data revealed no unexpected class issues, and phase 3 efficacy results posed no specific concerns. There is therefore no AdComm influence on the approval, and no linkages.
